name: Button
description: An action, pill-shaped on both platforms.

icon.description: A name from the icon list.

isIconOnly.description: Draws the icon alone; label then names the button.

label.description: The accessible name and tooltip. Required when isIconOnly.

isPending.description: A submit in flight: a spinner takes the icon's place and the label stays.

type.description: submit runs the Form's checks, then its onSubmit; reset restores every field's default.

onPress.description: Fired when the button is activated.
